tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Free-text search in the WYP.chat help centre, guides, glossary, industry pages and channel pages (French, Spanish, English). Returns the best matching pages with title, canonical url, Markdown url, type, language, last update and an excerpt. Read a result with get_doc_page.

tools.name: list_doc_pages
tools.description: Lists documentation pages by type (help, guides, glossary, industries, channels) and language (fr, es, en), in a stable order, with title, url and a one-sentence description. Both filters are optional; use offset to page through long lists.

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.description: Returns the Markdown of one documentation page, as published at its .md address. Pass the url from search_docs or list_doc_pages (https://wyp.chat/... with or without .md, or just the path). With lang, returns the same page in that language when it exists. Long pages are cut: continue with offset.
